documentation.content: A developer with the app visible has gone more than 2 hours without a successful scan, for at least 15 minutes (METRIC-4). Scans for visible tabs are due every 5 minutes, so scans are failing for someone: often GitHub (an outage or a rate limit), sometimes Gitilizer. Look at the dashboard's "Lists' staleness" charts and "Scans finished by outcome", and at the scan lines with `jsonPayload.outcome="error"` in the log, which name the error code. Developers whose GitHub can't be read at all are left out of the figures: they see why on their own screen.

conditions.displayName: A visible developer's list hasn't synced for 2 hours
